source_scope: Official Clay Mathematics Institute online problem descriptions and CMI prize rules; authored paraphrases are not formal claims of proof
coverage_metric: 10 required traceability fields per track, structural completeness only; not mathematical solution relevance or Clay approval

targets.official_target: For every nontrivial zero rho of the analytically continued Riemann zeta function, Re(rho)=1/2.
targets.quantified_scope: Every nontrivial zero in the critical strip, including multiplicities and arbitrarily large imaginary parts; no finite-height cutoff.
targets.permitted_solution_type: A universal theorem proving the zero-location assertion or a valid counterexample disproving it.
targets.hypotheses_and_conditions: Analytic continuation, functional equation, domain of the nontrivial zeros and all claimed spectral/determinant identities must be explicitly justified without using RH.
targets.probe_limit: A floating-point evaluation of the known first Li coefficient; cannot establish positivity for every index or locate all nontrivial zeros.
targets.missing_bridge: Prove a zero-location equivalence with the exact required hypotheses and then prove its universal conclusion; for the MathOS spectral route construct a self-adjoint operator and noncircular correspondence covering all zero multiplicities.
targets.direct_research_test: Propose a precisely stated all-index Li-coefficient inequality or a complete spectral zero-identity, attempt to prove it, and audit circular dependencies; finite numerical checks are regression tests only.
targets.required_proof_artifact: A complete inspectable proof that implies the zero-location statement for every nontrivial zero, with justified analytic domains, convergence and all dependencies.
targets.external_review_gate: Publish an actual claimed solution in a qualifying outlet; allow at least two years and establish general acceptance before any Clay consideration.

targets.official_target: Decide whether deterministic polynomial-time decision problems P equal nondeterministic polynomial-time decision problems NP.
targets.quantified_scope: All languages in the appropriate uniform complexity classes under standard finite bit encodings, not only fixed formulas or a restricted proof system.
targets.permitted_solution_type: Either a polynomial-time deterministic algorithm for an NP-complete language such as SAT with full correctness and bit-complexity proof (P=NP), or a general separation P!=NP.
targets.hypotheses_and_conditions: Fully specified machine/encoding and uniformity model, polynomial input-size bound, correctness on arbitrary encoded inputs; restricted resolution or circuit examples cannot by themselves separate P from NP.
targets.probe_limit: One six-variable unsatisfiable Tseitin formula and a short resolution refutation; no uniform worst-case polynomial SAT algorithm or unrestricted lower bound.
targets.missing_bridge: For the registered P=NP route, supply a deterministic SAT algorithm proved correct for every CNF and polynomial in total input bit length; a separate P!=NP route needs unrestricted algorithmic lower bounds.
targets.direct_research_test: Specify an exact candidate SAT algorithm and an infinite adversarial family, quantify total bit cost and verify correctness for all arbitrary inputs via proof; do not infer global complexity from finite benchmarks.
targets.required_proof_artifact: Complete formal argument in the chosen machine model proving polynomial-time decision of an NP-complete language or an unrestricted complexity-class separation.
targets.external_review_gate: Publish an actual claimed solution in a qualifying outlet; allow at least two years and establish general acceptance before any Clay consideration.

targets.official_target: Prove one of Clay's specified three-dimensional Navier-Stokes existence-and-smoothness or breakdown alternatives, with its full initial-data, forcing, domain and regularity assumptions.
targets.quantified_scope: Existence/smoothness on R^3 or the three-torus for every prescribed admissible smooth divergence-free initial datum with zero forcing, OR a valid counterexample to global smoothness satisfying one of the stated smooth-force breakdown formulations.
targets.permitted_solution_type: One of four official alternatives (A) unforced R3 smooth existence, (B) unforced periodic smooth existence, (C) forced R3 breakdown, or (D) forced periodic breakdown; all original conditions required.
targets.hypotheses_and_conditions: State viscosity nu>0, 3D domain, smoothness, divergence-free initial data, required decay/periodicity, permitted forcing and full PDE/pressure identities. Do not misreport a single smooth solution as a universal proof.
targets.probe_limit: Conditional L2 perturbation estimate for an explicitly known periodic ABC solution; assumes a smooth perturbed solution already exists.
targets.missing_bridge: A universal theorem for all data in an official existence alternative, or a fully qualified forcing/data construction for an official breakdown alternative; the conditional ABC Gronwall bound alone is insufficient.
targets.direct_research_test: Choose the precise official alternative A/B/C/D and its quantified hypotheses; write the missing global continuation estimate or candidate breakdown with full force/regularity audit, then seek rigorous proof or counterexample.
targets.required_proof_artifact: One mathematically complete proof satisfying all hypotheses of at least one official alternative, with PDE existence/nonexistence established and the chosen domain/forcing matched exactly.
targets.external_review_gate: Follow Clay's published rules and evaluation of any announced solution; do not treat an announcement as an accepted solution without official acceptance.

targets.official_target: Construct a nontrivial quantum Yang-Mills theory on four-dimensional R4 for every compact simple gauge group and prove a strictly positive mass gap.
targets.quantified_scope: Each compact simple gauge group G; a nontrivial Euclidean/R4 quantum theory and strictly positive physical mass gap in the reconstructed Hilbert-space theory.
targets.permitted_solution_type: A constructive proof of existence plus axiomatic reconstruction plus a positive mass-gap theorem in the required continuum and infinite-volume setting.
targets.hypotheses_and_conditions: Actual non-Abelian gauge field, continuum and infinite-volume limits, reflection positivity/reconstruction conditions at least as strong as required, nontriviality and physical spectral estimates.
targets.probe_limit: A two-state matrix with regulator-dependent positive lattice gaps; not a non-Abelian gauge field nor a continuum physical mass-gap proof.
targets.missing_bridge: Construct the required four-dimensional quantum field theory and prove regulator-uniform physical mass and reconstruction axioms for every required compact simple gauge group.
targets.direct_research_test: Work with a fully specified finite-volume lattice gauge action and prove a uniform physical-unit correlation/transfer gap bound alongside positivity and tightness assumptions, then connect the continuum limit rigorously.
targets.required_proof_artifact: A complete mathematical construction of the nontrivial 4D quantum Yang-Mills theory for all required G, verified axioms and a positive physical mass gap.
targets.external_review_gate: Publish an actual claimed solution in a qualifying outlet; allow at least two years and establish general acceptance before any Clay consideration.

targets.official_target: For every smooth complex projective variety, every rational Hodge class is a rational linear combination of classes of algebraic cycles of the corresponding codimension.
targets.quantified_scope: All smooth projective varieties over C, all relevant codimensions p and rational degree-2p classes of Hodge type (p,p), not just projective spaces.
targets.permitted_solution_type: Universal proof of the rational algebraic cycle class representation or a valid smooth projective rational-Hodge counterexample.
targets.hypotheses_and_conditions: Rational coefficients and Hodge (p,p) type are essential; do not substitute the false integral version or assume primitive class algebraicity.
targets.probe_limit: Multiplication in the known cohomology ring of P4; no primitive rational Hodge cycle construction for general varieties.
targets.missing_bridge: Construct algebraic cycle representatives for every remaining rational Hodge class under complete geometric hypotheses, including primitive pieces and valid reductions.
targets.direct_research_test: Choose a genuinely nontrivial family with computable rational Hodge classes; calculate the cycle-class image and isolate a precise primitive class not covered by existing generators.
targets.required_proof_artifact: A general geometric proof or correctly specified counterexample, with cycle-class maps and rational coefficients rigorously handled.
targets.external_review_gate: Publish an actual claimed solution in a qualifying outlet; allow at least two years and establish general acceptance before any Clay consideration.

targets.official_target: For every elliptic curve E over Q, the order of vanishing of L(E,s) at s=1 equals the Mordell-Weil rank of E(Q); MathOS additionally targets the refined leading-term formula.
targets.quantified_scope: All elliptic curves over Q, not just a fixed curve or finitely many good primes; for the refined version all prescribed arithmetic factors and normalizations.
targets.permitted_solution_type: Complete proof of the core rank/order-of-vanishing conjecture (and of the refined leading term if claiming full refined BSD), or a valid counterexample to the claimed generality.
targets.hypotheses_and_conditions: Correctly normalized Hasse-Weil L-function, analytic continuation and behavior at s=1; rational rank, regulator/period/Tamagawa/torsion and Sha hypotheses explicitly distinguished.
targets.probe_limit: Eight finite-field point counts for E:y2=x3-x; they provide local a_p data but cannot establish generic rank equality or Sha finiteness.
targets.missing_bridge: Prove equality of analytic and algebraic ranks for all elliptic curves over Q; for MathOS's stronger refined route also prove the full leading term and justify Sha finiteness.
targets.direct_research_test: For a declared nontrivial family, compute rigorously certified Selmer ranks and analytic orders near s=1, prove the comparison under complete hypotheses and identify where known rank-zero/one theorems stop.
targets.required_proof_artifact: Complete theorem on all elliptic curves over Q proving the rank equality; a separate complete refined BSD formula is required for MathOS's stronger target.
targets.external_review_gate: Publish an actual claimed solution in a qualifying outlet; allow at least two years and establish general acceptance before any Clay consideration.

targets.official_target: Every closed, simply connected three-dimensional manifold is homeomorphic to the three-sphere, as established in Perelman's solution.
targets.quantified_scope: All closed simply connected 3-manifolds, not merely triangulations already known to represent S3.
targets.permitted_solution_type: The Millennium problem is already solved and awarded; MathOS may independently reconstruct the established Ricci-flow proof, but that is a separate research goal.
targets.hypotheses_and_conditions: Topological closedness, dimension three and simple connectivity must be justified, with Ricci-flow/surgery arguments checked if reproducing Perelman's proof.
targets.probe_limit: Homology of the known boundary of a 4-simplex; homology alone does not imply simple connectivity or establish any universal classification.
targets.missing_bridge: Reconstruct the entire chain of relevant Hamilton-Perelman Ricci flow, noncollapsing, surgery/extinction and topological implication lemmas with sourced hypotheses.
targets.direct_research_test: Build an independently verified theorem-by-theorem dependency ledger for an existing complete proof, checking a substantive Ricci-flow lemma rather than only a simple triangulation.
targets.required_proof_artifact: A separately reviewed accurate reconstruction of the already accepted proof; not a new prize-eligible solution.
targets.external_review_gate: No second Millennium Prize is being sought for an already solved problem; distinguish an independent exposition/reconstruction from original accepted work.
